title: Grass is Green
description: A three track LP of original covers and compositions by the Redeemer music making team: Nate Gentilin (guitar, vocals), Kevin Deutsch (keys), Andrew Kalthoff (bass), and Blake Dadson (drums). Recorded by Raphael at the UC Santa Cruz Electronic Music Studios, May 2025.

tracks.title: Now the Green Blade Riseth
tracks.description: A funky cover of a Easter classic. Note the funk. It's funky.

tracks.title: Memory Box (The Burial)
tracks.description: Composed by Blake, for Blake's viking burial. Amazing lyrics by Nate. Mediocre mixing and mastering by Raphael.

tracks.title: Life in Desert Sands
tracks.description: "There is not a square inch in the whole domain of our human existence over which Christ, who is Sovereign over all, does not cry, 'Mine!'" - Abraham Kuyper
